card.name: Plant damage and symptom descriptions
card.fires_on: Small words and nouns inside descriptions of how plants (or fish) look when affected, such as 'by the plant aesthetics' or 'cause leaf burn'. It fires where a visible symptom or sign is about to be named.

modes.label: Plant symptom wording
modes.description: Linking words or nouns just before a described plant symptom like chewed leaf tips, wilting or burn.
modes.example: Most gardeners will notice the presence of adult weevils by<< the>> plant aesthetics.

modes.label: Other signs of trouble
modes.description: Words in non-plant observations of distress or cause, such as fish at the surface.
modes.example: You'll know the fish are in trouble when they're at the surface<<,>> gulping for air.

card.writes: It pushes away body-part and pain words like body, skin and pain, favoring other abstract or non-body nouns.
card.plain: It marks plant-problem descriptions, steering the text away from human body and pain words.
